It’s an adorably round sloth with soft striped navy-and-gray faux fur, a fluffy tuft on top, and a sparkly silver sequin belly with the embroidered Jazz note logo. The feet are sequined to match. It’s a fun gift for any Jazz fan, a cute piece for a kid’s room, or a great addition to a Utah sports collection. It’s in great pre-owned condition, with clean fur, bright sequins, and the tag still attached.
